findings.finding: signup enabled, email confirmation disabled, weak password baseline and privileged MFA disabled in local baseline
findings.remediation: harden Auth and prove privileged AAL2 before real users

findings.finding: no measured restore drill, RPO or RTO
findings.remediation: define targets and execute an isolated restore drill

findings.finding: local configuration models unrestricted database CIDRs and no SSL enforcement
findings.remediation: audit hosted settings and approve restrictions in a separate remote gate

findings.finding: real UAT would precede validated MFA enrollment and recovery runbooks
findings.remediation: keep real identities blocked until enrollment, recovery and break-glass tests pass

findings.finding: no operational alerting, incident ownership or immutable pilot audit export
findings.remediation: implement health checks, alerts, ownership and incident runbooks

findings.finding: platform and portal lack the security-header baseline already present on site
findings.remediation: share CSP, anti-framing, nosniff, referrer and permissions policy

findings.finding: platform login consumes redirect without an explicit internal-path allowlist
findings.remediation: centralize and test a fail-closed redirect validator

findings.finding: CI omits protocol, fiscal, import and Supabase migration test packages
findings.remediation: add all critical packages and SQL static gates to CI

findings.finding: GitHub Actions use floating major tags instead of immutable commit SHAs
findings.remediation: pin actions by SHA and document update cadence

findings.finding: local execution is Node 26 while applications require Node 22
findings.remediation: standardize Node 22 with version file and preflight

findings.finding: database reset seeding remains enabled and historical fixture risk is documented
findings.remediation: separate synthetic lab seeds from pilot reset policy

findings.finding: site CSP permits inline script and style
findings.remediation: plan nonce/hash adoption without blocking the synthetic rehearsal

findings.finding: platform environment template requests a server secret not used by current runtime paths
findings.remediation: remove unnecessary secret surface or document an isolated server-only consumer

findings.finding: CI has no dependency audit, secret scan, concurrency cancellation or generated-artifact guard
portal suite cannot run under unsupported Node 26 local runtime
findings.remediation: repeat under Node 22 and require parity with CI
